caption: The drawing shows a central, darkly shaded object resembling a sack or pouch with a quilted pattern on its lower, rounded portion. Attached above the pouch are two detailed depictions of rabbits or hares, hanging down with their bodies stretched and their heads facing downward, with one on each side of the central vertical axis. The rabbits' legs are bent and their feet drawn together at the pouch, while their ears are visible and pointing upwards. Both animals appear to be tied or attached to a strap or branch-like object that runs horizontally across the top of the image. The pouch features a looped strap above it, passing through a round ring or eyelet in the top center, and the upper portion of the image shows some gathered fabric or material tied together, with a visible red-brown cord forming a hanging loop. The entire composition is rendered in shades of brown, gray, and black, with careful crosshatching and shading to create volume and texture. The background is plain, off-white, and an outlined rectangle frames the illustration, with the name "EVELYN BAILEY" inscribed in small text in the lower right corner.
